svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province

North, south, east and west elevations; materials
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set

solar water heaters on north slope

M6 galvanised steel casement windows, powder-coated,
0.53 mm IBR, AZ150 Zincalume, pre-painted (Chromadek) Charcoal; 15° main / 5° verandah
PV modules on aluminium rails (rail clamps to purlins); SWH on stainless frames
225 mm fibre-cement fascia & barge, 125 mm Zincalume gutters, 75 mm Ø downpipes to channels
190 mm block, 15 mm cement plaster 1:5, primer + 2 coats exterior acrylic, colour Off-white
600 mm band, alkali-resistant primer + 2 coats enamel, colour Graphite (wash-down)
Hot-dip galvanised steel casements, polyester powder-coat Charcoal, 4 mm clear / obscure
Pressed-steel frames; 44 mm steel-faced doors (external), powder-coated Charcoal
100×100×3 SHS posts, 150×65 lipped-channel beam, signage band on fascia (client branding)
